testcase.system-out: Scenario: Switch between states with different feature suppression ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And the user creates model states Capture State and Copy State ✔ And the user sets the extrusion to Suppress in Primary and Capture State and Compute in Copy State through the model-state table ✔ And the user activates Copy State ✔ And The MCAD Software has a part with Primary and Copy State model states ✔ And the extrusion is suppressed in Primary and computed in Copy State ✔ And Copy State is active and its solid body is visible ✔ When the user activates the Primary model state ✔ Then the Primary model state is marked active ✔ And the solid body is absent from the viewport ✔ And the extrusion row is dimmed and struck through ✔ When the user activates Copy State ✔ Then Copy State is marked active ✔ And the solid body is visible in the viewport ✔ And the extrusion row is no longer struck through
